LanguageData.PF_AtmosphereRegulator.label: atmosphere regulator
LanguageData.PF_AtmosphereRegulator.description: Supplies oxygen, filters toxic air and regulates pressure in sealed rooms on planets with explicit survival rules. Each powered unit serves roughly 100 cells; larger rooms respond more slowly. Open exterior doors, power loss and breakdowns remove protection. Does not shield radiation or control temperature. Odyssey vacuum still requires an oxygen pump.
